desc: negative: Test use-after-free with DRR/NETEM/BLACKHOLE chain
pre: ip link add dummy1 type dummy && ip link set dummy1 up
ip link set dev dummy1 up || true
ip addr add 10.10.11.10/24 dev dummy1 || true
tc qdisc add dev dummy1 root handle 1: drr
tc filter add dev dummy1 parent 1: basic classid 1:1
tc class add dev dummy1 parent 1: classid 1:1 drr
tc qdisc add dev dummy1 parent 1:1 handle 2: hfsc def 1
tc class add dev dummy1 parent 2: classid 2:1 hfsc rt m1 8 d 1 m2 0
tc qdisc add dev dummy1 parent 2:1 handle 3: netem
tc qdisc add dev dummy1 parent 3:1 handle 4: blackhole
tc class del dev dummy1 classid 1:1

readback.cmd: tc -j class ls dev dummy1 classid 1:1
readback.name: verify
